# polygons.library: IsOnSegment

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> True when `q` lies on the segment \[a, b\], endpoints included: collinear with it
> and within its bounding box.

## Signature

```plato
IsOnSegment(q: Point2D, a: Point2D, b: Point2D): Boolean
```

### Line 473

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 473](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L473).

```plato

    //==
    // # Ring predicates and repair
    //
    // `Polygon2D` declares simplicity — at least three vertices, no edge crossings —
    // as an invariant, and until now nothing in the tree could check it. These are
    // that check and the repairs that establish what is establishable, so that the
    // constructive operations above and in `triangulation.library.plato` can state
    // "precondition: simple" and have callers able to honour it.
    //
    // Conventions fixed here:
    //
    //   * Coincidence and collinearity are tested EXACTLY, with no tolerance. A
    //     tolerance would make these predicates disagree with the bodies that consume
    //     them, which are exact throughout, and would silently merge distinct vertices
    //     of a finely sampled ring. Callers wanting a tolerant answer should snap their
    //     input first.
    //   * The predicates are O(n^2): every pair of edges is tested. A sweep-line is
    //     the standard improvement and is separate, later work.
    //   * The repairs are TOTAL — every ring has an answer, including a degenerate one,
    //     which they reduce rather than reject. `RemoveCollinearVertices` of a
    //     zero-width spike is empty, and that is the honest result.

    // True when `q` lies on the segment [a, b], endpoints included: collinear with it
    // and within its bounding box.
    IsOnSegment(q: Point2D, a: Point2D, b: Point2D): Boolean
        => TwiceSignedArea(a, b, q) == 0.0
        && q.X >= a.X.Min(b.X) && q.X <= a.X.Max(b.X)
        && q.Y >= a.Y.Min(b.Y) && q.Y <= a.Y.Max(b.Y);
```
